main.description: An entity-as-actor MIRROR record (ADR-2606042330). One public/power entity datafied by a knowledge-graph actor (ooyake / kabuto / tsumugi / kanjo / watatsuna / watari) → one keyless did:web mirror-actor. This is etzhayyim's public-fact record of the entity, NOT the entity itself and NOT an official channel (no impersonation, G1). Natural persons are NOT representable here (G3): there is no person-subject field, and performerType cannot be 'person'.

handle.description: single-label actor handle, e.g. 'corp-tw-tsmc' / 'gov-afg-adm1-af-bal'. Resolves did:web:etzhayyim.com:actor:<handle>.

namespace.description: entity namespace; selects the owning KG actor + ontology

entityId.description: source kotoba entity id, e.g. ':company/id org.corp.tw.tsmc' — the dotted id the handle is derived from

displayName.description: the entity's public name (organization/system label — never a person)

isMirror.description: G1 — ALWAYS a mirror; an entity-actor never speaks AS the entity

serverHeldKey.description: G5 — the server holds NO key for this actor; verificationMethod is empty (mirror of on-chain ERC725, never server-minted, ADR-2605231525)

performerType.description: G3 — organization or system ONLY. 'person' is deliberately excluded (a public organ / legal person / craft, never a natural person)

ownerActors.description: KG actor handle(s) that maintain this mirror (e.g. ['kabuto','tsumugi','kanjo'])

sourcing.description: G7 sourcing honesty — most seed entities are :representative

disclaimer.description: G1 observation-only disclaimer; MUST open the profile description
